items.guidance: Inspect the s6-overlay service definitions referenced by docker/Dockerfile (init-db-migration, svc-web, svc-workers) and record each run script's command. The web command (svc-web, serving the Next app on port 3000) becomes the image default; svc-workers becomes a Procfile or package.json worker entry using its exact command. init-db-migration is a one-shot task, not long-running, so report it as a candidate for the Deployz per-release migration command rather than a worker.

Search the Next app's routes (app/api or pages/api) for an existing health, healthz, ping or status route and report its path if found. If none exists, add a minimal GET route handler returning 200 with no database or tRPC calls, and exclude it from any Next middleware matcher that enforces auth or redirects. Then report the path for the Deployz health check setting.

Check the database package and its configuration (drizzle config, env schema) for any PostgreSQL driver, DATABASE_URL, or database type setting, and report what exists. If only better-sqlite3 with a file path (for example under a DATA_DIR setting) is supported, report that evidence and note the data would be lost on every deploy.
